Use original typed Training command peers in resident origin test

The actual locked/offline compiler rejected a Readback connection passed to the Candidate fixture's Command connection argument. Use the existing original Fresh or Recovered command-peer factory matching each existing pairing, exposed only through the existing cfg(test) ports module.

All eight origin pairings, actual protected Root observations, issuer sequence and zero-frame assertions remain unchanged. Actual pinned formatting exits zero with no changes; six origin source guards pass. Native and ordinary qualification remain pending.

Append only the seven existing authenticated caller paths reported by the exact a4a full caller run. Preserve every prior caller, forbidden pattern, guard and authority rule. Append the precise new CALLERS size-allowlist hash.

No Rust, scanner, tests or runtime budgets change. The preceding a4a full caller failure is retained; the child full gate remains pending. Ordinary LEARN qualification stays zero.
